Follow .github/copilot-instructions.md.
Build features/hero and features/about following the screenshot.
Hero: TextReveal for name and role, summary, availability badge ('Immediate Joiner'),
CTAs (Schedule Interview, Download Resume), social icons, profile image via next/image

stat cards from profile.stats with count-up animation, parallax, scroll indicator.
About: glass card with summary and highlights, Reveal on scroll.
